Border formalities at the Bhutan Gate
Check in and the rest of the day free
2: Breakfast, then north into the hills towards Thimphu
The Chukha dam and the Wang Chhu gorge on the way
Optional: the Zorig Chusum school of arts
Arrival transfer and check in for the night
3: Breakfast, then out into the capital
The Memorial Chorten and the Buddha Dordenma

Wangdue Phodrang Dzong on its rocky spur

expert.name: Tenzin
expert.quote: Nine nights in five star properties including Six Senses at Gangtey and Le Méridien in Paro. The best of Bhutan without compromise.
expert.tip: Six Senses Gangtey is the one to arrive at in daylight. The whole lodge is built around one window onto the crane valley.

summary: 10 days through Phuentsholing, Thimphu, Phobjikha, Punakha, Paro, with 9 nights, daily breakfast and a licensed Bhutanese guide: the thimphu sightseeing with simtokha dzong, the wangdue phodrang dzong, the gangtey and the phobjikha valley, the punakha sightseeing tour.
included: Included: 9 nights across Phuentsholing, Thimphu, Phobjikha, Punakha, Paro with daily breakfast; all land transfers by private vehicle; the Thimphu sightseeing with Simtokha Dzong; the Wangdue Phodrang Dzong; the Gangtey and the Phobjikha valley; the Punakha sightseeing tour; the Ta Dzong and Rinpung Dzong; the Hike to the Tiger's Nest; the Haa valley day trip; a licensed Bhutanese guide; permits and the sustainable development fee as quoted.
not_included: Not included: international and domestic flights; lunches and any meals not listed; monument entrance fees where not stated; travel insurance; personal expenses.
